info.title: thunder-dbf: dBASE and FoxPro tables from the command line
info.description: thunder-dbf: check, inspect, import, export and migrate dBASE and FoxPro data from the command line.

options.name: --plan
options.description: Only show the shape it would create

options.name: --shape-only
options.description: Create the empty table, without rows

options.name: --format
options.description:
dbase3, dbase4 (default), foxpro2 or vfp
thunder-dbf migrate <folder> <file.db>      Copy every table into a SQLite database (the folder is only read)

options.name: --replace
options.description:
Recreate SQL tables that already exist
thunder-dbf export <table.dbf> [file.csv]   Write a table out as CSV (UTF-8)

options.name: --raw
options.description: Don't protect spreadsheet users from formula text (=, +, -, @)
